reasons_add: Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī (TABATABAI:6:122-127/r1) states that God gives each thing its form before directing it toward its created perfection.
Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī (TABATABAI:6:122-127/r1) expressly applies creational guidance to each kind and each individual, including its appointed course and lifespan.
Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī (TABATABAI:6:122-127/r1) distinguishes creational guidance and describes it as directing each kind and individual toward its created perfection, acts, appointed course, and lifespan.
Al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī (TABATABAI:6:122-127/r1) links God's giving each thing its form and guiding it to 87:2–3.
